title: Additive Manufacturing (AM) Builds
description: Near-net-shape lattice/porous structures, organic contours, internal channels impossible with subtractive methods
designPrinciples: Material: Grade 5 (Ti-6Al-4V) is the most common AM titanium alloy. Grade 23 ELI for medical implants requiring higher ductility and lower oxygen content.
Form: AM builds start from atomized metal powder (Grade 5 / Grade 23 powder). Substrate plates are standard bar/plate stock.
comparisonNotes: Standards: ASTM F2924 (Grade 5) / ASTM F3001 (Grade 23 ELI), HIP + annealed, 100% CT scan + mechanical test coupons
